taxonomy_appendix_M_I1.note: append-only taxonomy record: the V8-era single label FORM15_TERMINATED is split into FORM15_12B (12(b) exchange-registration termination) and FORM15_12G (12(g) class termination). No V8 artifact is edited; this appendix applies the split to the V9 census retroactively.
taxonomy_appendix_M_I1.death_definition: DEATH_CANDIDATE = the Form 15 class table terminates COMMON STOCK (company-level termination; section cited and EDGAR form label are recorded metadata, not discriminators). Reorg-survival cases (e.g. Baxter 2021) remain in this bucket by design and are removed from DEAD_EVIDENCED only by the P0b price-survival cross-check. Earliest in-window covered-common filing per CIK is the evidenced death filing date.
